composition.rule: Decode and preserve complete P1347/P1346/P1345 semantics. Replace only the parent observation transaction, freshness state machine, phase-local reason precedence, exec-to-exit trace lifecycle and P1348 adapter exception boundary.

parent_transaction_binding.pidfd_open: pidfd_fd = os.pidfd_open(child_pid_from_fork, 0) immediately in the parent. Keep the exact descriptor open through waitid and waitpid. fstat identity is captured once and compared before terminal wait; substitution/reopen is forbidden.
wait_order: close parent copies of child pipe endpoints
drain dedicated parent stdout/stderr read endpoints to EOF under limit/deadline
mark exact transaction terminal exactly once
parent_transaction_binding.wait_consistency: waitid.si_pid and waitpid return equal child_pid_from_fork. For normal exit, waitid.si_code is CLD_EXITED, waitid.si_status equals WEXITSTATUS(raw_wait_status), WIFEXITED is true and child_signal is null. Signal cases use the exact corresponding CLD code, signal and raw-status derivation. Any disagreement is WORKER_AUTHORITY.
parent_transaction_binding.pipe_consistency: For each logical pipe, pre-fork endpoints have the same st_dev/st_ino and FIFO mode; post-close parent endpoint equals its captured pre-fork identity. Only child endpoint is inheritable/mapped to 0/1/2. Parent accepts output only from retained captured endpoints and recomputes length/digest.
parent_transaction_binding.transaction_id: Fresh parent-generated 32-byte opaque identifier, stored in the session transaction table and never accepted from worker/corpus/adapter.
parent_transaction_binding.internal_tag: HMAC-SHA-256(session_secret, RFC8785(["p1348-parent-transaction-r1", transaction_id, exact internal record])). session_secret and authoritative record remain parent-memory-only. Constant-time tag and exact-record comparison occur before projection and again before freshness commit.
parent_transaction_binding.public_rule: Projection is output evidence only and carries no internal tag or session secret. No validation API accepts projected evidence as authority. A test mutating one public/internal field must be rejected against the internal transaction before classification.
parent_transaction_binding.framing_before_parse: Zero/partial/truncated stdout, missing sole trailing LF, extra LF/value/bytes, output overflow, nonempty stderr, timeout, signal, unexpected exit or captured length/digest mismatch is WORKER_AUTHORITY. Only one complete frame reaches duplicate-key and schema parsing.

freshness_registry_binding.identity_formula: identity_bytes = RFC8785(["p1348-execution-identity-r1", challenge_hex, invocation_nonce_hex, invocation_sha256, case_sequence_sha256, schedule_slot]); identity_sha256 = SHA-256(identity_bytes)
freshness_registry_binding.schedule_slot: Exact ASCII identifier from a parent-frozen ordered session plan. The registry owns next_expected_slot; worker/case/adapter cannot choose or reorder it.
begin_transaction: Strictly validate 32-byte distinct parent challenge/nonce, invocation formula, sequence digest and schedule slot.
Acquire the single registry lock; require slot is next_expected_slot and identity absent from pending and consumed.
Generate unpredictable parent token, insert one PENDING record, release lock. Concurrent duplicate/reorder is WORKER_AUTHORITY.
freshness_registry_binding.commit_transaction: Under the same lock require exact PENDING token, transaction_id and unchanged next_expected_slot; atomically delete PENDING, append one CONSUMED record at the next zero-based commit ordinal and advance next_expected_slot. Return success only after this commit.
freshness_registry_binding.rollback: Any failure before commit removes only its matching PENDING record under lock and changes neither consumed list nor next_expected_slot. Failure during/after atomic commit is an integration blocker and never reopens the identity.
freshness_registry_binding.replay: A second begin for a PENDING or CONSUMED identity is WORKER_AUTHORITY before spawn/response acceptance. A first canonical validation may pass; byte-identical replay in the same session must fail.
freshness_registry_binding.registry_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(ordered array of [commit_ordinal, schedule_slot, identity_sha256, transaction_id] for every CONSUMED record)), with no LF in the preimage
freshness_registry_binding.fresh_orders: Normal, repeat and reverse occupy distinct ordered slots and use pairwise-new challenge, nonce, invocation and identity in one non-reset session registry. Normalized result projections omit fresh secrets/digests but retain slot and commit ordinal.

reason_precedence_binding.meta_blocker: ADAPTER_EXCEPTION is outside the classification reason enum and aborts integration before score. It cannot be counted as a killed mutation.
worker_phase_order: closed envelope/type/key/order including injected pid -> SCHEMA
dag_phase_order: external/original anchor and real validator AUTHORITY_ROOT pass-through
reason_precedence_binding.adapter_transport: Adapter returns the exact observed classification and first reason without mapping AUTHORITY_ROOT to DAG_VALIDATOR or any transport reason to SCHEMA. Unexpected adapter exception triggers meta_blocker.

trace_lifecycle_binding.setoptions_rule: At exact initial SIGSTOP, invoke PTRACE_SETOPTIONS once for same pidfd-backed PID with data exactly setoptions_mask = TRACEEXEC|TRACEEXIT|EXITKILL. Missing/extra substituted mask or syscall failure is PROBE_AUTHORITY.
trace_lifecycle_binding.event_predicate: For each trace event, waitpid returns child_pid; WIFSTOPPED is true; WSTOPSIG is SIGTRAP; event = (raw_status >> 16) & 0xffff.
trace_lifecycle_binding.exec_event: Exactly first traced event after initial continuation is PTRACE_EVENT_EXEC. exec_event_count becomes one. While stopped, authenticate /proc/<pid>/exe exact fstat/mode/size/SHA-256 against retained sealed memfd and external executable pin before request delivery.
trace_lifecycle_binding.exit_event: After request and continued execution, require exactly one PTRACE_EVENT_EXIT and no second exec or unexpected stop. At this stop call PTRACE_GETEVENTMSG for same PID into an unsigned-long parent buffer, record exit_event_message, set exit_event_count to one and PTRACE_CONT exactly once.
terminal_order: compare exit event message semantics with waitid and raw waitpid status
trace_lifecycle_binding.normal_exit_consistency: For canonical exit 0: event message decodes as normal exit 0, waitid.si_pid equals child_pid, waitid.si_code equals CLD_EXITED, waitid.si_status equals 0, waitpid returns child_pid, WIFEXITED(raw) and WEXITSTATUS(raw)==0. Noncanonical terminal state is PROBE_AUTHORITY.
trace_lifecycle_binding.detach_rule: Parent never calls PTRACE_DETACH and remains tracer through terminal wait. Detach at exec stop, before EXIT, at EXIT, tracer loss, terminal without prior EXIT, second EXEC or sibling status is PROBE_AUTHORITY.
trace_lifecycle_binding.unknown_gate: Only after exec_event_count==1, exit_event_count==1, exact sequence/status/image/pipes/memfd postconditions and inherited primitive checks may canonical opaque payload be Unknown/OPAQUE_PAYLOAD.

adapter_boundary_binding.authorship_order: P1348 oracle and adversarial suite hashes freeze before P1348 adapter authorship. Adapter consumes both and cannot modify their expected vectors.
p04_operation: capture original_open = checker.os.open and every other patched object in the same swap-after-exec-stop function scope
invoke the canonical checker API exactly once
restore every captured object in finally
adapter_boundary_binding.exception_rule: Any exception from import/setup/mutation/invocation/cleanup/restoration produces the canonical blocker and aborts the run. It yields no case classification/reason and cannot enter numerator/denominator as a killed negative.
adapter_boundary_binding.no_fabrication: Adapter never constructs parent transaction, registry state/tag, wait observations, validator reason, ptrace event/message, classification or witness.

root_formulas.contract_root_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1348-contract-root-r1", step_p1348_sha256, step_p1347_sha256, p1347_blocker_sha256, p1347_contract_spec_sha256, p1347_contract_binding_sha256, p1347_contract_receipt_sha256, p1348_contract_spec_sha256, p1348_contract_binding_sha256]))
root_formulas.execution_authority_root_sha256: SHA-256(RFC8785(["p1348-execution-authority-root-r1", contract_root_sha256, oracle_checker_sha256, oracle_caller_sha256, oracle_authorship_receipt_sha256, adversary_suite_sha256, adversary_authorship_receipt_sha256, adapter_sha256, adapter_authorship_receipt_sha256]))

authority_and_artifact_binding.external_anchor: Verifier receives P1348 delivery-receipt whole-file SHA-256 out of band, validates its closed schema and walks every predecessor before import or execution. No artifact self-pins or consumes a successor.
authority_and_artifact_binding.classification_owner: Only verifier derives case classification from authenticated raw checker/validator observations. Oracle, adversary, adapter, corpus and receipts do not supply accepted answers.

new_negative_variants: integration blocker; identity remains consumed and cannot be reopened
WORKER_AUTHORITY if stream authenticity fails, otherwise AUTHORITY_ROOT pass-through
adapter_meta_test: must emit ADAPTER_EXCEPTION_BLOCKS_INTEGRATION under historical adapter; repaired adapter control must complete without exception and allow P04 to produce PROBE_AUTHORITY
focal_binding.acceptance: Zero valid survivors at each slice, exact reasons, no adapter blocker in the candidate adapter run, score 1.0, zero regressions, normal/repeat/reverse deterministic with fresh identities, transport Unknown zero and only authenticated canonical probe Unknown.

forbidden_bindings: validate_worker accepting a public evidence dictionary instead of an internal transaction handle/record.
Any child_pid, pidfd, pipe, waitid or waitpid field independently replaceable without internal transaction failure.
Registry supplied/reset by worker, corpus, adapter or receipt; replay accepted; failure consuming a fresh identity; concurrent/reordered commit not rejected.
Partial/extra stdout classified SCHEMA, DAG answer channel classified SCHEMA, or validator AUTHORITY_ROOT collapsed into DAG_VALIDATOR.
PTRACE_SETOPTIONS without TRACEEXEC|TRACEEXIT|EXITKILL, terminal wait without exactly one EXIT event, detach before terminal, second exec or payload parse before lifecycle completion.
Adapter exception converted to expected case result, missing same-scope original_open capture, restoration outside finally or failed restoration ignored.
Oracle/adversary/adapter self-judgment, internal trust anchor, protected-input rewrite or weakening of any P1347/P1346/P1345 obligation.
Full corpus, RED, productive candidate, 38-capsule implementation, L0/consumer change, final certificate or general-equivalence claim.

budget_and_stop.stop: Two revisions without causal gain, any survivor, score below 1.0, reason relaxation, regression, protected drift, adapter exception/fabrication, missing complete tracing, freshness ambiguity, transport Unknown, static-gate failure or scope expansion blocks P1348.

closed_metadata.rule: Exactly these top-level keys in this order. All process bindings, registry transitions/commit order, reason precedence, ptrace options/events/statuses, adapter blocker behavior, focal vectors and budgets are closed. Duplicate/unknown keys or alternate transport is invalid.
